connect.title: Connect your agent
connect.intro: Two steps: make a token, then add CodeXArtifacts to your client. Your tokens are listed below.
connect.step1.title: Create a token
connect.step1.name: Token name
connect.step1.once: Shown only once. It is already filled into step 2.
connect.step1.failed: The token could not be created. Try again.
connect.step2.title: Add CodeXArtifacts to your client
connect.step2.waiting: The commands use {placeholder} until you create a token in step 1.
connect.codex.run: Set the token in your environment, then add the server:
connect.other.where: Add this to ~/.cursor/mcp.json (or .cursor/mcp.json in a project). Other clients that take a remote MCP server use the same shape:
connect.try.title: Then try it
connect.tokens.title: Your tokens
connect.tokens.empty: No tokens yet. The one you make in step 1 will be listed here.
connect.tokens.name: Name
connect.tokens.confirmHint: Whatever uses it stops working right away. This can't be undone.
connect.tokens.failed: The token could not be revoked. Try again.
connect.try.prompt: Publish a one-page summary of this repo to CodeXArtifacts.
connect.activity.title: Recent activity
connect.activity.help: Client names and versions are provided by clients. Last used includes successful requests without a recorded connection.
connect.activity.failed: Activity could not be loaded. Try again.
connect.activity.empty: No activity recorded yet. Use your agent to publish or update an artifact, then check here.
connect.activity.emptyToken: No recent activity for this token.
connect.activity.moreFailed: More activity could not be loaded. Your current list is still here.
connect.oauth.intro: Add this workspace to your agent, then sign in and approve access in your browser. No token to copy.
connect.oauth.manual: Use a personal access token instead
connect.oauth.title: Connect with your browser
connect.oauth.instructions: Add this MCP server URL in your client. When prompted, sign in to CodeXArtifacts and review the access request.
connect.oauth.claude: In Claude Code, open /mcp and authenticate CodeXArtifacts to continue in your browser.
connect.oauth.codex: Follow the browser sign-in opened by Codex.
connect.oauth.others: For other OAuth-capable MCP clients, use the same server URL and their sign-in action. Clients without OAuth can use a personal token below.
connect.oauth.grantsHint: Each authorization belongs to your account. Client names are self-reported; use the client ID to tell them apart.
connect.oauth.failed: Authorized clients could not be loaded. Try again.
connect.oauth.empty: No authorized clients yet. Connect your agent using the server URL above.
connect.oauth.revokeHint: This client loses access immediately. Other authorizations and personal tokens keep working. You can authorize this client again later.
connect.oauth.revokeFailed: The authorization could not be revoked. Try again.
connect.oauth.access: This client will act as {user}: read artifacts and shared data you can access, and create, edit, share or delete content wherever your account is allowed. Your existing sharing permissions still apply. It can stay connected until you revoke its authorization.
connect.oauth.warning: Client names are not verified. Only approve a client you just started connecting and trust with your artifacts.
connect.oauth.manageHint: You can revoke this authorization at any time on Connect your agent.
